programme.desc: The third episode focuses on the header. No less than 15% of all goals in the Eredivisie are scored with the head. Of all ball contacts during a football match, on average 7.7% are with the head. This means that during 1 Eredivisie season no fewer than 28,000 heads are made. It has also been known for years that heading is not good for your health. It increases the risk of ALS, Parkinson's disease and dementia. – The third episode focuses on the header. programme.desc: The fifth episode focuses on the free kick. A successful free kick is the ultimate proof that your feet can do what your head wants. At the beginning of this century there were regularly more than forty hits per season, but in recent years the number has not even exceeded fifteen. Where have the specialists such as Pierre van Hooijdonk and Lasse Schöne gone? – The fifth episode focuses on the free kick. programme.title: Wild New Zealand | S01E02
programme.desc: A three-episode documentary revealing the secrets of the flora and fauna of the remote islands of New Zealand, the last land discovered and inhabited by humans. For 80 million years, life went on there in its own strange way. With the arrival of people, new species of animals arrived there, such as merino, ermine, and kakapo, the only flightless species of parrot in the world, found only there. In the far corner of the Pacific Ocean lies New Zealand, cut off from the rest of the world since the time of the dinosaurs. Fauna and flora developed here in a unique way. In this lost world, nature has special rules: penguins in the forest, parrots in the snow and predators as if taken straight from prehistoric times. Representatives of flora and fauna must struggle with the geological forces that have provided the beauty of this land. Here you can meet pioneers conquering mountain peaks, dolphins emerging from the depths of the sea, and birds hunting with masterful agility over hot streams. Great Britain. 2016. documentary film

programme.title: New Zealand: Mythical Islands – Drift | E01
programme.desc: Viewers have the opportunity to better understand the nature and geographical conditions of the island chain, isolated from other ecosystems. The authors present unique regions of New Zealand. They also observe the everyday life and habits of the most tough and resistant inhabitants of this area. Since the age of dinosaurs, New Zealand's wild areas have been cut off from influences from other environments. For this reason, even today, local landscapes hide many fascinating secrets. The local forests are inhabited by, among others: predators from the Jurassic period. Great Britain. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: New Zealand: Mythical Islands – Wildlife | E02
programme.desc: Viewers have the opportunity to better understand the nature and geographical conditions of the island chain, isolated from other ecosystems. The authors present unique regions of New Zealand. They also observe the everyday life and habits of the most tough and resistant inhabitants of this area. Representatives of New Zealand's wild fauna are exceptionally diverse. They include extremely intelligent parrots, dangerous snails, and glowing insects. Great Britain. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Texas: Alligator Rescue – Graduation Day | E10
programme.desc: Gator Country researchers, experts and interns educate viewers about alligators. Their task is to save those predators that have left their habitats and gotten lost. Then they move the animals to a reserve where they can function peacefully... USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Scotland – Highlands | E01
programme.desc: The Scottish Highlands are dominated by rocky hills and valleys. Climate change and humans have caused many changes in the region. Despite this, many wild animals still live here. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Scotland – Islands | E02
programme.desc: Scotland's picturesque coastline is filled with hundreds of islands. Residents learned to live in harmony with wild animals and protect the surrounding waters from pollution. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Scotland – Lowlands | E03
programme.desc: Over 80% of Scotland's population lives in lowland areas. Wildlife used to be confined to these areas, but now animals can even appear in cities. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Kielder Forests – Spring | E01
programme.desc: Kielder Forest is the largest forest in England. The creators decided to take a closer look at the animals living there. We will learn how they adapt to the changing seasons. Some of them decide to stay there during this process, and some leave it for the winter... Great Britain. 2021. documentary series

programme.title: African predators: the big four – Leopards | E02
programme.desc: The lives of the four largest predators living in Africa will be presented. The creators will look at their hunting methods, competition in herds, as well as strategies that ensure their survival in sometimes difficult conditions... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions – The Fat Years | E02
programme.desc: The life story of young lions. The everyday challenges they have to face throughout their adolescence will be shown. The triumphant moments after the hunt will be presented, as well as the dangers to which... Germany is exposed. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: In search of snow leopards: Chasing the shadow | E01
programme.desc: A documentary series about the life of snow leopards - the most mysterious and least known of all big cats. The material was shot in the Spiti Valley in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh... Germany. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Animals: masters of survival – Artists | S01E03
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories. In this episode, the filmmakers present the candidates for the title of the world's most extravagant creature. They are awarded bronze, silver and gold medals in the category of natural freak or even showman. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: David Attenborough: Those wonderful eggs
programme.desc: Bird eggs nurture new life, protecting it from the outside world while allowing it to breathe. They are strong enough not to break under the full weight of the incubating parent, and fragile enough for the chick to escape. From creation to hatching, Sir David Attenborough reveals the rich process behind these natural wonders. Along the way, he shares stories about the eggs of a whole range of birds - from swans and their aquatic world, to the cliffs where the common guillemot lives and lays its eggs... Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Around the world with David Attenborough – Force of nature | E03
programme.desc: When Sir David Attenborough, the British writer, traveler and popularizer of nature knowledge, turned 80, many thought it was the end of his career. However, it turns out that it was quite the opposite. Attenborough made a series of nature films examining the development of life on Earth, from its origins at the bottom of the ocean to the present day. He presents the results of his research in a series of documentary films... Great Britain. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Earth – planet of life – Great extinction | E03
programme.desc: Earth has survived countless collisions and disasters in the solar system. From asteroid impacts to volcanic eruptions and climate crises. The program will show what some of them looked like... Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Earth seen from space – Patterns and patterns | S01E02
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. When the Earth is viewed from space, its surface is covered with multicolored spots and shapes. Modern technology and a completely new perspective will allow you to look at, among others, elephants in the Congo and wombats burrowing in the Australian wilderness. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Extreme Life – Hot | E03
programme.desc: Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – In extreme conditions | S01E03
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. Sharks, which appeared on Earth before dinosaurs, have adapted to life even in the most unfavorable environments. Scientists are investigating the secret of their evolutionary success. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Monsters from the depths | E01
programme.desc: Steve Backshall will show viewers the world of giants located in the depths of the sea. Thanks to the help of experts and biologists, they will learn more about the giant squid, anglerfish, megalodon, and other fascinating animal species. The presenter will present creatures inhabiting the depths of the sea and their behavior. He will present, among others: anglerfish and black snailfish, which can be found at depths of 500-3800 m below sea level. Great Britain. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: 30 for 30: One and Not Done
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World

programme.title: Heroes of evolution

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: In Antarctica, large groups of penguins fight for survival every day. Impressive photographs capture their life in one of the most extreme regions on earth. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Snakes, lizards and the tuatara in New Zealand exhibit a fascinating diversity - from camouflage to venom. Insights into the world of reptiles beyond common myths. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Fascinating hoofed animals in the spotlight: giraffes, zebras, camels and rare species such as okapis and vicunas live in extreme habitats - from the desert to the rainforest. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: How do tiny animals survive in a world of giants? Insects – the most diverse group of animals – conquer almost every habitat with amazing strength, endurance and agility. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Intelligent and colorful: squid, squid, cuttlefish and nautiluses are among the most mysterious sea creatures. A glimpse into the world of molluscs with arms and tentacles. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Wolves, foxes, coyotes and their relatives such as maned wolves and red dogs show how versatile wild dogs are: powerful, threatening - and surprisingly social. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Koalas, wombats, Tasmanian devils and other marsupials live in Australia and America. They carry their young in their pouches and move by hopping, climbing or gliding. (Station info).

programme.title: Animalically aloof
programme.desc: There is ruthless competition in the sky: more than 10,000 species of birds roam there. What techniques and tricks have they developed to survive? (Station info).

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise
programme.desc: Patagonia's extreme nature poses great challenges for the animals. Condors, pumas, flamingos and rare rodents have to cope with polar winds, ice fields and deserts. (Station info).

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise

programme.title: Wild dogs: hunters between worlds
programme.desc: The secrets of canid success: their survival in extreme regions, their family structures and their amazing methods of foraging. (Station info).

programme.title: The tiny wonders of nature

programme.title: Animal heartbreakers

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
